newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee weakens vs dollar and stg.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee weakens vs dollar and stg.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee weakened against both dollar and sterling on Tuesday reflecting international market trends, foreign exchange dealers said.
The rupee was quoted at a commercial mean rate of 20.4645 to the dollar from 20.4115 on Monday, and at a commercial mean rate of 33.593 to the sterling from 33.4635 on Monday.

Forex dealers said that dollar and sterling strengthened on overnight international markets. They added that the dollar's fixing for the coming days would depend on the outcome of Tuesday's policy-making Federal Open Market Committee meeting.
On the local forex market, dealers said that there was demand from importers for hard currency and commercial banks were in shortage positions.
